title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement

messages.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – ball bearing 6306-2Z C3 (part:360020)
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for your offer. Our expected volume is 20000 pc per year. We propose a multi-year volume agreement of 24 or 36 months from 2027-01-01. In our meeting on 27 June you told us this is the kind of agreement that moves prices.

The forecast for part:360020 increased by 4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

A longer term gives you planned base volume and removes the workload of yearly renewals. Payment at 60 days continues our current arrangement. Our proposals are attached.

Which of these packages could you sign, and are there cheaper variants of the 6306-2Z C3 you would suggest?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – ball bearing 6306-2Z C3 (part:360020)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. Thank you for the updated forecast; however, our pricing is already highly optimized for this product. 

Our current proposal is a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months. As an alternative, we can agree to a 24-month contract with 30-day payment terms at €4.88 per unit, which corresponds to a price of €4.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.26 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.08 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.05 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Ball bearing 6306-2Z C3 (part:360020): revised multi-year packages
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for your revised offer and the cost-reduction options. We have moved our proposals a clear step towards you. The attached packages keep the volume at 20000 pc per year for 24 or 36 months from 2027-01-01. They give you a stable planned base without yearly renewals, and one variant keeps your 30-day cash terms.

In June your owner offered to walk us through the calculation of hourly rates and material. We would welcome that to settle the price on a fact basis. Could you also complete the lot-size saving figure, which was cut off in your e-mail?

Which of the attached packages can you sign?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Ball bearing 6306-2Z C3 (part:360020): revised multi-year packages
messages.body:
Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.
Our terms: a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months.
Here is the background.
Thank you for your revised proposals; however, we cannot offer further price reductions for these terms, and we ask for the data supporting your target prices.
Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.
We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands.
Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.
Our conditions follow our Preisliste and discount tiers.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
